title: Noise threshold
description: Two bold primary-color prints exchange places through a continuous, seeded erosion field.
useCase: Scrub or reverse an organic reveal at exact progress values without changing the underlying pattern.
interaction: Scrub the reveal in either direction.
reducedMotion: The composition only updates on direct input; there is no autonomous motion or animated easing.
limitations: A fixed five-octave value-noise field masks two original procedural compositions. No images or video are sampled. Requires WebGL 1; static SVG artwork appears during failure or context loss, and the renderer rebuilds on restoration.
look: Flat primary-colour poster art: cobalt field with cream concentric rings and red stripes, broken by cloudy yellow patches with black shapes, above a cream slider.
motion: Scrubbing the slider thresholds a fixed five-octave noise field, eroding the blue composition in cloudy patches into the yellow and black one; reversible, with no autonomous motion.
adapt: The dissolve is `reveal` in `fragment`: a `smoothstep` around the seeded `noise` `threshold`, compared with `mix(-.1,1.1,value)`, edge softness `.028`. `front` and `back` are the two procedural compositions; swap them for texture samples or your own artwork.
